blocks.content: Quiz: Which of the following is an HTML comment?
Tap an option below to answer:
<-- This is a comment -->
Incorrect, give it another shot!
This code is missing an exclamation mark after the starting <. Therefore, it is not a comment.
This code is missing an exclamation mark after the starting <. Therefore, it is not a comment.
<!-- This is a comment -->
Correct Answer!
An HTML comment starts with <!-- and ends with -->.
An HTML comment starts with <!-- and ends with -->.
// This is a comment
Incorrect, give it another shot!
An HTML comment doesn't start with //.
An HTML comment doesn't start with //.
